title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience and self-help capacities of women, girls and children in Lebanon
Stärkung der Resilienz und Selbsthilfekapazitäten von Frauen, Mädchen und Kindern im Libanon

description.narrative: Der Druck der Existenzsicherung, unverarbeitete Traumata und Perspektivlosigkeit entladen sich bei Geflüchteten oftmals in häuslicher Gewalt, von der vor allem Mädchen und Frauen betroffen sind. Statistiken von 2023 zeigen, dass in der Projektregion 94 % Frauen und Mädchen von sexueller und geschlechtsspezifischer Gewalt betroffen sind. The pressure to secure a livelihood, unresolved trauma and a lack of prospects often result in domestic violence among refugees, which primarily affects girls and women. Statistics from 2023 show that in the project region 94% of women and girls are affected by sexual and gender-based violence. The aim is therefore to strengthen the target group by promoting mental health, ensuring physical safety, strengthening resilience and teaching basic professional skills so that they can build their own networks, assert themselves within their families and seek help when needed.
